questions.q: The Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) was cited as one reason for pressure on India's forex reserves. What does LRS primarily allow individuals to do?

However, high outflows under this scheme have lately contributed to the decline in the country's foreign currency holdings. When the Rupee weakens past 95 per dollar, these outflows become an even greater concern for the central bank.
